reviews.conclusion: The exit portal is entered after completion, followed by the End poem/credits from proxy 3.0 through 98.75 s. This bounds the credits at approximately 95.75-96.25 s, compatible with the -95.9 s deficit. The on-screen run timer remains frozen. This is post-completion footage rather than an established in-run splice.

Repeated options/menu visits total 7.0-9.5 s within the flag bracket, compatible with -9.1 s at proxy precision. Horizontal compressed game views at 4.25-7.5 and 15.25-17.75 s obscure pause state, so the exact total remains unresolved. The separate loading sample at clip start precedes the flag and is not used to explain it.

This is after the completed run and credits. The player opens settings, clears SeedQueue, saves/quits, visits the title/world-selection screens, and reloads the same post-run location. Later another pause menu is held. Visible menus and reload behavior explain why a continuous gameplay-clock assumption fails, but the -6.125 s deficit is not closed exactly; loading does not necessarily suspend the GUI clock for its full duration.

The player exits a Nether portal, sets a bed, dies, respawns in the same stronghold, and proceeds to the End. This is a visible same-attempt death/respawn rather than an established fresh seed. Four menu sequences total about 2.5-4.5 s, compatible with the -3.3833 s deficit; death-screen time itself is not assumed to suspend the GUI clock.

This footage occurs after completion and the long End credits. The player opens settings and LAN configuration, initially showing Allow Cheats OFF and then ON near source 627.1 s. Menu duration is approximately 2.75-4.25 s, compatible with the -3.1917 s deficit. Enabling cheats here is a visible post-completion action and does not establish use during the timed run.

Bastion traversal and inventory handling include three video/options sequences. Visible menu exposure totals approximately 1.5-3.0 s, compatible with the -2.65 s deficit. Inventory time is kept separate from pauses.

Fortress gameplay contains settings/video menu pairs at proxy 2.25-2.5 and 11.75-12 s. Their combined 0.5-1.5 s sampled bounds contain the 1.317 s deficit. No exact native-frame closure is established.

coverage.interpretation: Evidence-span interpolation between events in resolved, nonambiguous segments; not proof of continuity throughout those spans or the whole video. Matching heart modes are inference alternatives, not observed heart states.
